Proofs

Why the Quran is from God

What the Quran is and does, each point with its verses and a fair answer to the objection.

The open challengeThe Quran invites anyone in doubt to produce even one sura like it, with any helper they choose.One message, twenty-three yearsThe Quran invites close reading, and says a book from any other source would hold much inconsistency.It reasons with youOn resurrection and creation, the Quran gives a reason and leaves you to finish the thought.A book that says thinkThe Quran's word for reasoning appears 49 times, always as a verb: something a person does.Look, then look againThe Quran points to what anyone can see, and asks you to look closely and think.The preserved wordThe Quran says God guards it. History adds an early settled text, recited ever since.The RomansWhen the Romans lay defeated, the Quran said they would win again within a few years.He read no book before itThe Quran says its reciter had recited no scripture and written none before it came.It corrects its own prophetThe Quran, recited by him, reviews his own conduct in public, and it is recited to this day.A book not about himThe Quran names Moses 136 times, Mary 34, Jesus 25, and Muhammad 4.Justice even against yourselfThe Quran commands fairness against yourself and your family, and toward a people you dislike.A man named while he livedA short sura names a living opponent, and scholars read it as saying he would not believe.Words that move the heartThe Quran speaks of skin that shivers, hearts that soften and eyes that fill at its words.Reports of the unseenThe Quran says it tells its Prophet of scenes he never witnessed.The last bookThe Quran calls Muhammad the seal of the prophets, and says the religion has been made complete.
